Wash and trim the stalks.\\n\\n\",\"question\":\"how to prepare baby broccoli\"}", "answer": "To prepare baby broccoli, you can either sauté or steam it. For sautéing, add about 1 tablespoon of oil to a sauté pan and heat it over medium-high heat until it sizzles. Then, add the baby broccoli to the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until it becomes tender and bright green. Stir or toss the broccoli constantly so all sides cook evenly without overcooking. Season with a touch of butter, salt, and pepper, and serve warm. \n\nFor steaming, fill a pot with 2 to 3 inches of water and set a steamer basket on top so that it sits above the water. Bring the water to a boil over high heat. Lay the baby broccoli in the steamer basket and place the lid on top.
